world.title: Infrastructure that spans nations demands protection that outlasts decades.
world.body: From the Nile Delta to the Arabian Gulf, the pipelines and facilities that power modern civilization face relentless attack. Every joint, every weld, every exposed surface is a front line.

problem.title: Corrosion doesn't announce itself.
problem.body1: It works silently — inside pipelines transporting crude and water, beneath thermal insulation, along buried infrastructure. By the time it's visible, structural compromise has already begun.
problem.body2: The question is never whether corrosion will occur. It is whether your system is engineered to stop it before it stops you.

methodology.title: A three-phase discipline.
methodology.subtitle: Every USE engagement follows the same rigorous sequence — no shortcuts, no compromises.

assess.title: Assess
assess.desc: Detailed pipeline inspection, corrosion mapping, and condition assessment using API-compliant protocols. We quantify the threat before we prescribe the solution.

engineer.title: Engineer
engineer.desc: Material selection, system design, and application engineering tailored to operating pressure, temperature, chemistry, and regulatory requirements.

execute.title: Execute
execute.desc: Factory application and on-site installation by certified USE technicians, backed by full QA documentation, third-party inspection, and lifecycle support.
